source.name: Building Data Genome Project 2 (BDG2)
source.publisher: Building and Urban Data Science (BUDS) Lab, National University of Singapore, with the ASHRAE Great Energy Predictor III organisers
source.paper: Miller, C., Kathirgamanathan, A., Picchetti, B. et al. The Building Data Genome Project 2, energy meter data from the ASHRAE Great Energy Predictor III competition. Sci Data 7, 368 (2020).
source.license: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 (CC BY-SA 4.0), as stated in the LICENSE file of the repository
source.energy_unit: kWh per hour (whole-building electricity meters); the numeric value equals the average demand in kW over that hour
source.timestamp_convention: Local clock time of the site as published, no daylight-saving gap or repeat (exactly 17,544 hourly rows); the site time zone is in the metadata
source.note: BDG2 is described by its authors as non-residential data in general; this project uses only the buildings whose metadata primary use is 'Lodging/residential' (student residence halls and similar), excluding hotels.
